title: FontFace
description: An EMBEDDED WEBFONT token (CSS Fonts 4 §4 @font-face): one typeface whose bytes ride INLINE in the generated style.css as a data: URI (RFC 2397), so the stylesheet stays self-contained — no CDN, no third origin, a CSP needs only `font-src data:`. The opt-in alternative to the zero-load system stack (tokens/font.ts SYSTEM_FONT_STACKS); the family is prepended to the brand stack, which stays the fallback. This schema is the STRUCTURE; tokens/font-face.ts (Zod) additionally decodes src and enforces the file signature (wOF2/wOFF), the decoded-size budget (131072 bytes), weight.min <= weight.max, and that family is not a generic keyword. Tradeoff (size, licensing) documented in tokens/GROUNDING.md, 'Typeface'.

family.description: the face's family name, emitted as a quoted CSS string (letters, digits, spaces, hyphens). MUST NOT be a generic family keyword (CSS Fonts 4 §5.1.1).

src.description: the font file as a base64 data: URI — font/woff2 (preferred) or font/woff (RFC 8081). Never a URL: an embedded face fetches nothing.

weight.description: the font-weight descriptor range (CSS Fonts 4 §4.5); min = max for a static face, a span for a variable font. min <= max.

display.description: font-display (CSS Fonts 4 §4.9), locked to swap: text paints at once in the fallback stack, never invisible while the face decodes.

license.description: SPDX id of the font's license. Embedding redistributes the file to every visitor, so only licenses permitting redistribution + embedding are constructable (fail-closed).

$sha.description: content address: sha256 of family|weight|style|src, first 12 hex.
